release.content: pubkit 0.31.4 was released on 2026-11-09 from commit fbd8fa9c6e0a7e2f926d9561cab09e5a5b67ec84 with these changes.

rows: CI: the reusable workflows try each setup step (make venv, npm ci, a repository's own), each hash-locked install of tests/requirements.lock and pip-audit up to three times, 15 s apart, and the managed pubkit.mk's venv target its install likewise, as pip retries no 504 and GitHub's release downloads sometimes answer one; a finding still fails pip-audit, as it fails each try. pubkit deploy walk --fulfil: a generated secret that is in Bitwarden but misshapen is planned as "replace NAME (misshapen: why)", not as generating a new one, so the typed yes knows a value goes. The dependency review leaves the owner's own reusable workflows and actions, which carry no license GitHub reads, out of its license check alone: pubkit sync lists those a repository's workflows call in .github/dependency-review-licenses.txt, of which the review takes only the owner's, and without the file it leaves out pubkit's and pubrel's; advisories still apply to them
